quote: We adapted Walker and Avant's 11 concept analysis model to develop a framework for analysing the concept of public involvement in research.

From this analysis, defining attributes were identified to clarify the meaning and nature of the concept of public involvement in research. Five operational definitions were created to exemplify the concept. These were as follows: undefined involvement; targeted consultation; embedded consultation; co‐production; and user‐led research.
